# Capture test fixture

These reusable Backstory and proposed Ground truth files preserve the former
Everyday memory capture Scenario's one-candidate, ten-no-candidate Scene mix.
Ground truth uses the current schema, with separate Muse nomination and
Provenance capture decisions. Capture replay and Ground truth reviewer tests
use the fixture. Validation resolves the shared capture run configuration from
`synthetic-journal-evaluation/generation-presets/`.

This fixture is not an adopted evaluation dataset. Tests construct their own
temporary review records and reports. The saved original Scenario and its
migration-only successor were deleted at the developer's request on
13 September 2026. This current-schema regression fixture remains available.
